question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Speaking disrespectfully about sacred or religious things
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Blasphemy"** means speaking disrespectfully about sacred or religious things. (ईश-निंदा)

 
 
• **Example: **He was accused of blasphemy for making disrespectful remarks about the church.
 
 
 
• **"Blasphemy"** refers to any act, utterance, or writing showing contempt or lack of reverence for God or something sacred. (ईश-निंदा)
 
 
• **Example: **The writer faced severe backlash for his blasphemous comments in his latest book.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Biped** (द्विपाद): An animal that walks on two legs.

 
 
• **Example:** Humans are bipeds, meaning we walk on two legs.
 
 
 
• **Belligerent** (युद्धकारी): Hostile and aggressive.
 
 
• **Example:** The belligerent nations were on the brink of war.
 
 
 
• **Bigamy** (द्विविवाह): The act of marrying someone while already being married to another person.
 
 
• **Example:** He was charged with bigamy after his first wife discovered he had married another woman.
